recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中骨小樑明顯增厚、不規則並彼此連接成網狀（osteosclerosis），骨髓腔被纖維性、梭形細胞為主的基質取代，造血細胞稀少，符合原發性骨髓纖維化晚期的骨硬化。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular bony trabeculae forming an interconnecting meshwork (osteosclerosis)
Irregular, broad-based bone with appositional new bone formation and scattered osteocytes
Intertrabecular spaces largely replaced by fibrous stroma with spindle cells in streaming fascicles
Marked reduction of recognizable hematopoietic cells and fat
Low-power H&E view; megakaryocyte morphology not assessable at this magnification
describe_en: Low-power view of an H&E-stained bone marrow trephine biopsy shows markedly thickened and irregular bony trabeculae that branch and interconnect to form a dense meshwork, occupying a large portion of the core. The narrowed intertrabecular spaces are filled by fibrous stroma with spindled cells arranged in streaming fascicles, with markedly reduced hematopoietic elements and fat. Findings are consistent with osteomyelosclerosis, compatible with the overt fibrotic stage of primary myelofibrosis in the setting of pancytopenia and massive splenomegaly; trichrome and reticulin stains help grade collagen fibrosis.

ddx.vs: Osteoblastic metastases also cause new bone and fibrosis but contain cohesive epithelial nests that are cytokeratin positive.
Hyperparathyroid bone disease shows peritrabecular fibrosis with numerous osteoclasts and dissecting resorption (tunneling) rather than interconnecting sclerotic bone without osteoclast excess.
Paget disease shows mosaic cement lines with numerous large osteoclasts and osteoblastic rimming in a vascular fibrous marrow, without atypical megakaryocytes.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or systemic mastocytosis with fibrosis
ddx.vs: HCL shows a fried-egg lymphoid infiltrate (CD20/annexin A1+), and mastocytosis shows spindled CD117/tryptase-positive mast cell aggregates, while both lack a diffuse sclerotic bone meshwork.
